definitions.short: literally a director , i.e. the spindle or shank of a distaff , by which it is twirled
definitions.full: H3601. kishor כִּישׁוֺר noun [masculine] distaff (etymology dubious; perhaps, if meaning correct, from כשׁר (compare Sta § 216 Lag BN 182 ) = be straight , because it stands erect, De Str; ᵑ6 industry ; whence כּוּשְׁרָא ᵑ7 , and likewise כּוּנְשְׁרָא ᵑ7 , also Prov 3:8 , (for Hebrew שׁר ), where Levy wirbelsäule , Str on the passage Jastr navel ; but Str doubts etymological connection with כישׁור ); — only in בַכִּישׁוֺ֑ר שִׁלְּחָה יָדֶיהָ 31:19 (|| ׃ מָּֽלָךְ whirl of spindle). — As above De Now Str RV SS and others; > Ki AW Thes Rob-Ges whirl of spindle (AV spindle ); see מֶּלֶךְ .
